purpose: Rights-safe candidate list for maps, charts, places, people timelines, Christ connections, and sermon-presentation visuals. This is a review manifest, not a public image import.
rights_policy: Use only public-domain source scans, internally created charts, or locally owned images.
Do not copy modern study Bible charts, modern Bible software maps, modern atlas artwork, or copyrighted ministry graphics.
Every public visual must keep source URL, rights note, recommended use, and review status.
Scripture references should use KJV references and KJV wording only when quoting Scripture.
